title: How much is this?
subtitle: 이거 얼마예요?
review: Written by Claude. The Korean and the romanization have not been checked by a Korean speaker. No audio yet: the Korean voice is not chosen. English support only: no Burmese lines were written.
intro: A customer compares prices in a shop. Listen for the three prices.
steps: Press Play all with the text hidden. Who is speaking, and where are they?
Listen again, then answer the questions under the dialogue.
Tap the lines to show the text, and listen once more while reading.
Shadow it: play a line, press Pause (or the space bar), say it aloud, then Resume.
Take a role and say your lines in the pauses.

tr.en: Excuse me. How much is this?
And how much is that one over there?
Then I'll take that one, please.

questions.q: How much is the first thing she asks about?
questions.why: Geugeoneun man wonieyo = That one is 10,000 won.

questions.q: What does she say about the 20,000-won one?
questions.why: Jom bissaneyo = It's a little expensive.
The assistant shows one for 8,000 won, and she says: Geureom geugeo juseyo.

notes: igeo = this (near me). geugeo = that (near you). jeogeo = that over there.
bissayo = it is expensive. jom = a little.
